sloka: गृहीतश्चैव पृष्टश्च काले दृष्ट: सकारण: ।कच्चिन्न मुच्यते चोरो धनलोभान्नरर्षभ ॥ २.१००.५८॥
transliteration: gṛhītaścaiva pṛṣṭaśca kāle dṛṣṭa: sakāraṇa: ।kaccinna mucyate coro dhanalobhānnararṣabha ॥ 2.100.58॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I trust that your ministers are wellinformed and look into all matters in times of hardship pertaining to whether a man is rich or poor without any bias to either.
